name: Everforest Dark

provenance.bg.surface: spec: bg1 = Cursor Line, Status Line (active), Tab Line background
provenance.bg.raised: choice: next neutral step above the popup fill bg2 (spec bg3 = inactive tab label background)
provenance.bg.overlay: spec: bg2 = Popup Menu, Floating Window background
provenance.bg.stripe: derived: bg.base darkened to 1.06:1 (weakest fill; bg.inset is too strong here, 1.17:1 vs inactive selection 1.15:1) - zebra rules in layout-archetypes §2.4
provenance.fg.muted: spec: grey2 = Cursor Line Number, Tab Line Label (inactive)
provenance.fg.faint: spec: grey0 = Line Numbers, Foreground UI Elements
provenance.fg.on-accent: spec: bg0 = Tab Line Label (active), drawn on statusline1
provenance.fg.title: spec: orange = Title (vim Title group; ports use fg 2/2)
provenance.border.default: spec: bg4 = Window Splits Separators; consensus inactive border bg4 2/4
provenance.accent.secondary: choice: categorical contrast with green (aqua/blue sit next to green)
provenance.selection.fg: consensus: selection fg bg0 1/2; spec bg0 = label on statusline1
provenance.status.success: spec: green = Hint Messages; cross-scheme success = green
provenance.tab.active.bg: spec: statusline1 = Tab Line Label Background (active)
provenance.diff.removed: spec: red = Diff Deleted Signs; consensus 2/2
provenance.diff.changed: spec: blue = Diff Changed Text background; consensus 1/2

notes: No terminal-emulator port is published; ANSI slots come from colors/everforest.vim terminal colors (black = bg3, white = fg, brights = normals). cursor/selection null.

ansi16 overrides (hue-aware nearest slot that clears the contract floor; dim modelled as 55% blend): accent.primary -> '2' (slot 2 is the closer match to #a7c080; slot 2 = #a7c080, 6.23:1) | border.focus -> '2' (slot 2 is the closer match to #a7c080; slot 2 = #a7c080, 6.23:1) | keyhint.key -> '2' (slot 2 is the closer match to #a7c080; slot 2 = #a7c080, 6.23:1) | link -> '2 underline' (slot 2 is the closer match to #a7c080; slot 2 = #a7c080, 6.23:1) | fg.muted -> '7' (default 'default dim' resolves to 3.37:1; now 7.38:1) | fg.faint -> 'default dim' (default '8' resolves to 1.55:1; now 3.37:1) | tab.active.bg -> '2', tab.active.fg -> 'bg bold' (the theme draws a filled active tab: #2d353b on #a7c080)
